Participants: Asha (Project Manager); Rahul (Backend Lead); Meera (Frontend Lead); Karan (QA Lead); Neha (Data Lead)
Transcript:
Asha: Welcome to the NovaCRM rollout kickoff. Our target pilot launch remains 30 September 2026.
Rahul: Backend will own customer-profile and authentication APIs.
Meera: Frontend will own the advisor dashboard.
Neha: My team will handle migration of legacy customer records.
Karan: QA will prepare the end-to-end test plan.
Asha: First milestone is API contract freeze by 12 August. Rahul owns that. The first migration dry run is planned for 24 August, owned by Neha.
Karan: I need stable API contracts before finalising regression cases.
Asha: Main early risk is dependency on the vendor SSO sandbox, which is not yet available.
Meeting_Summary: Pilot target set; initial owners and milestones agreed.

Transcript:
Meera: The dashboard needs customer search, portfolio summary, service requests and interaction history.
Priya: Interaction history must mask PAN and account numbers for non-authorised roles.
Rahul: I can expose role-based masking from the API.
Asha: Decision: role-based masking will be enforced server-side, not only in the UI.
Priya: Compliance sign-off on masking rules is needed by 18 August.
Asha: Priya will provide the final masking matrix by 14 August so Rahul can implement it.
Karan: I will add masking checks to the security test cases.
Meeting_Summary: Server-side masking decision; compliance matrix due 14 Aug.

Transcript:
Rahul: The customer-profile, authentication and interaction APIs are documented.
Meera: Frontend reviewed them. We need one field renamed from cust_id to customer_id.
Rahul: Agreed. I will update the spec today.
Asha: Are we freezing the contract?
Meera: Yes from frontend.
Karan: Yes for QA.
Asha: Decision recorded: API contract is frozen today, 12 August. Rahul remains owner of any backward-compatible corrections.
Rahul: The SSO sandbox is still pending from the vendor.
Meeting_Summary: API contract frozen on schedule; SSO remains a blocker.

Transcript:
Vendor: The SSO sandbox is now available.
Rahul: Good. I will start integration today.
Karan: When can QA test login?
Rahul: I can provide a QA-ready build by 21 August.
Asha: Rahul owns SSO integration. Karan will run login and session-expiry tests after the build is deployed.
Vendor: Production certificates require a separate request.
Asha: I will submit the production certificate request by 19 August.
Karan: Risk noted: if production certificates are delayed, pilot login could be affected.
Meeting_Summary: SSO sandbox received; QA-ready build due 21 Aug.

Transcript:
Priya: The masking matrix was delivered on 14 August as planned.
Rahul: Server-side masking is implemented for PAN and account number.
Karan: Security test execution starts tomorrow.
Priya: One more requirement: exported CSV files must also mask sensitive fields.
Rahul: Export currently uses a separate service. I will patch that by 25 August.
Asha: Owner is Rahul, deadline 25 August.
Priya: Compliance sign-off is moved from 18 August to 27 August because we added the CSV export control.
Asha: Record the revised sign-off date as 27 August.
Meeting_Summary: CSV export masking added; compliance sign-off revised to 27 Aug.

Transcript:
Neha: Dry run one completed with 98.7% records migrated successfully.
Asha: What failed?
Neha: 1.3% failed because legacy phone numbers contain invalid characters and some customer IDs are duplicated.
Rahul: Duplicate IDs will affect API lookups too.
Neha: I will clean the invalid phone-number records by 26 August. Data Governance, not my team, must resolve duplicated customer IDs.
Asha: Who is coordinating with Data Governance?
Neha: I will coordinate, but Data Governance owns the actual duplicate-ID correction.
Asha: Next dry run is 31 August.
Karan: Migration defects are a medium risk until success rate exceeds 99.5%.
Meeting_Summary: Dry run achieved 98.7%; duplicate IDs are an external dependency.

Transcript:
Rahul: CSV export masking patch was completed on 25 August.
Karan: Security tests passed for UI, APIs and exported files.
Priya: I reviewed the evidence. Compliance approves the masking implementation.
Asha: So compliance sign-off is complete today, 27 August.
Priya: Correct.
Karan: One low-severity finding remains: session timeout warning text is unclear.
Asha: Meera will update the warning text by 1 September. This does not block compliance approval.
Meeting_Summary: Compliance sign-off complete; low-severity UI text issue remains.

Transcript:
Neha: Second dry run completed at 99.72% success.
Data Governance: Duplicate customer IDs have been corrected.
Neha: Remaining failures are mostly records with missing mandatory email fields.
Asha: Is 99.72% sufficient for pilot?
Karan: From QA, yes if the failed records are quarantined and reported.
Neha: I will create a quarantine report and exclude those records from pilot migration.
Asha: Decision: proceed with pilot migration approach using quarantine for invalid records. Neha owns the quarantine report due 3 September.
Data Governance: We will continue cleansing the source system separately.
Meeting_Summary: Migration threshold achieved; quarantine approach approved.

Transcript:
Karan: End-to-end testing starts today. We have 84 scenarios.
Meera: Advisor dashboard build is feature complete.
Rahul: Backend APIs are in the staging environment.
Neha: Quarantine report was delivered this morning.
Karan: Initial smoke test found a defect: interaction history sometimes shows duplicate entries after refresh.
Rahul: That sounds backend-related. I will investigate.
Asha: Rahul owns defect DEF-17. Target fix is 7 September.
Karan: Until fixed, interaction-history regression is blocked.
Meeting_Summary: E2E testing started; DEF-17 assigned to Rahul for 7 Sep.

Transcript:
Rahul: DEF-17 was caused by retry logic and is fixed in staging today.
Karan: We retested and duplicate interaction entries no longer appear.
Meera: I have completed the session-timeout warning text change.
Karan: We have three medium defects remaining, none in login, masking or migration.
Asha: What is the regression completion target?
Karan: Full regression will complete by 14 September, owned by QA.
Asha: Good. Rahul's DEF-17 is closed.

Participants: Asha; Rahul; Meera; Karan; Neha; Priya
Transcript:
Karan: Regression is 76% complete and currently on track for 14 September.
Neha: Final pilot migration rehearsal is complete at 99.81%.
Priya: No open compliance blockers.
Meera: Frontend is ready.
Rahul: Backend is ready, but production SSO certificates have not arrived.
Asha: I submitted the certificate request on 19 August and escalated yesterday.
Karan: That is now the only high risk for pilot readiness.
Asha: Contingency: if certificates are not received by 18 September, we will escalate to the vendor account director and evaluate a one-day launch shift. We are not changing the 30 September target today.
Meeting_Summary: Production SSO certificate is the only high risk.

Transcript:
Karan: Full regression is complete today as planned. 82 of 84 scenarios passed.
Asha: What about the other two?
Karan: Two low-severity cosmetic defects remain: column alignment and a tooltip typo.
Meera: I will fix both by 16 September.
Karan: They do not block pilot.
Rahul: We also received the production SSO certificates this afternoon.
Asha: Excellent. That closes the high-risk SSO item.
Karan: I will run a production-certificate connectivity test on 15 September.
Meeting_Summary: Regression complete; SSO risk closed after certificate receipt.

Participants: Asha; Rahul; Meera; Karan; Neha; Priya
Transcript:
Karan: Production-certificate connectivity test passed.
Meera: Both cosmetic issues were fixed on 16 September.
Neha: Pilot migration package and rollback scripts are ready.
Priya: Compliance has no objections to pilot launch.
Asha: Decision: we are GO for the 30 September pilot.
Rahul: Who will monitor APIs on launch day?
Asha: Rahul owns API monitoring; Karan owns incident validation; Neha owns migration monitoring; Meera owns UI support.
Asha: I will coordinate the command centre.
Meeting_Summary: Formal GO decision for 30 Sep pilot.

Transcript:
Asha: Final checkpoint before pilot.
Rahul: API dashboards and alerts are configured.
Meera: UI support runbook is complete.
Karan: Test closure report is signed.
Neha: Migration files are frozen. We will begin pilot migration at 06:00 on 30 September.
Asha: Any new risks?
Karan: Only operational risk is slower response during peak support hours.
Asha: Mitigation is a dedicated command-centre bridge from 06:00 to 18:00 on launch day.
Rahul: No technical blockers from backend.
Meeting_Summary: No technical blockers; launch-day command centre confirmed.

Participants: Asha; Rahul; Meera; Karan; Neha; Priya
Transcript:
Asha: The NovaCRM pilot launched this morning.
Neha: Migration completed at 08:10 with 99.83% records loaded. Quarantined records were reported separately.
Rahul: API availability has been 99.98% so far.
Meera: No critical UI incidents.
Karan: We logged four support tickets: three user-how-to questions and one low-severity display issue.
Priya: No compliance incidents were reported.
Asha: Decision: keep the pilot open and proceed with the planned two-week observation period.
Asha: Karan will prepare the pilot quality report by 5 October. Rahul, Meera and Neha will provide metrics to Karan by 3 October.
Meeting_Summary: Pilot launched successfully; observation period begins.
